target.description: Candidate ordered source subtask is Figure 6g–h: predict whether contralateral reaction time is in the fastest or slowest within-session quartile from simultaneously recorded DMS spiking. This is explicitly a scoped paper subtask; Figure 3 timing and the paper’s full causal demixing claims remain distinct obligations, not silently replaced or won.

dataset.description: Article-linked Zenodo 17457318 behavioral/electrophysiology release; author decoder reads data-published/NpxData/npx_DMS.mat variables S and SU. Exact archive/member identity and row manifest have not been verified here.

cohort.description: Paper Figure 6h reports 18 sessions from eight rats, restricted to sessions with at least five simultaneously recorded DMS units and contralateral trials. Exact qualifying sessions and rat mapping require an authenticated manifest.

split.description: Paper uses tenfold within-session cross-validation and selects among 11 ridge strengths from 10^-4 to 10^-0.2 by minimum classification error. Author code does not pin fold RNG/assignment in the inspected function; recovering the published split/selection realization is unresolved. A leave-rat-out split would be an extension.

inputs.description: Trial-by-neuron-by-time DMS spike tensor from 0 to 0.5 seconds after reward-port assignment, flattened as predictors. Reaction times determine fast/slow labels; they are scoring labels rather than candidate input. Same neural and behavioral availability must hold for comparator and candidate.

preprocessing.description: Author code applies recording-hemisphere rules, excludes ipsilateral trials, forms log2 reaction-time quartiles and nearest-grid 0–0.5-second spike windows. The code assigns thres(1) but then indexes thresh(1), so outlier filtering cannot be silently repaired and called the original executable baseline.

metric.description: Per-session cross-validated classification accuracy in percent: 100 times one minus the minimum kfoldLoss among the 11 ridge penalties. It is a source selection-biased CV statistic, not an independent external test accuracy.

aggregation.description: Figure 6h reports the mean across 18 sessions from eight rats. Caption describes SEM but inspected plotting code passes unscaled SD to errorbar; the correct published uncertainty and numerical session scores remain unresolved.

full_panel.description: Reproduction is first-class and must retain the original physiological and decoder findings: all 37 main-figure numerical root obligations (plot_fig1c, plot_fig1d, plot_fig1f, plot_fig2d, plot_fig2e, plot_fig2f, plot_fig2g, plot_fig3ab_latency, plot_fig3ab_xcorr, plot_fig3c, plot_fig3d_left, plot_fig3d_right, plot_fig3e_left, plot_fig3e_right, plot_fig3f, plot_fig3g_left, plot_fig3g_right, plot_fig3h_left, plot_fig3h_right, plot_fig4c, plot_fig4d, plot_fig4f, plot_fig4g, plot_fig4h, plot_fig4i_left, plot_fig4i_right, plot_fig5c, plot_fig5d, plot_fig5ef, plot_fig5g, plot_fig5h, plot_fig6a, plot_fig6b, plot_fig6ce, plot_fig6d, plot_fig6f, plot_fig6h) plus every quantitative Extended Data 1-10 control. Figure 6h requires all 18 sessions/eight rats and all 11 penalties, not a copied mean or 17/18 count. Figure 3 retains all 120 latency rows, six complete signed curves, 40 within-rat descriptions, eight paired-rat descriptions and two pooled comparisons as historical interface granularity, with authentic source equivalence still unresolved. The scalar/categorical findings list is a partial source summary only. Required arrays are not represented there: complete reward-by-block wait curves; event-aligned head-speed/heading; all reward/delay/side-conditioned DA/ACh traces; full six signed cross-correlations and source support; reward/delay TD value and predicted/actual initiation histories; every native regression coefficient and lag; analytical waiting-value curves; prior-delay wait contrasts across all offers; complete port-poke probability functions; source example-cell firing curves; offer-cue slope histograms; full movement/fast-slow fluorescence traces and decoder example-cell traces; and every Extended Data1-10 quantitative/anatomical control family. Original source indices, time/lag/category axes, reference arrays and complete derivation/verification remain mandatory and unresolved. No array is typed as scalar, no generic array-conformity category is an original finding, and no scalar or categorical summary waives the numerical companions. If only structured-output support remains after source definition, that is an engineering schema_blocked state rather than scientific ineligibility. Preserved physiological findings remain distinct from improvement of the scoped decoder.

permitted_observations.description: Both paper_data and paper_data_author_code must receive identical authenticated original released observations, scientific identities and budgets; the pinned official author code is the only added information in the second condition. Original source analysis uses behavior, spike, DLC movement and aligned photometry observations as appropriate to each physiological endpoint. For Figure 6h, candidate prediction inputs are the original trial-by-neuron-by-time 0-0.5-second contralateral DMS spikes; held-out RT-derived fast/slow labels and final native outcomes are operator-owned. Legitimate training-fold labels, fold masks and source class construction require a frozen delivery policy; no leave-rat-out or final-label-adaptive substitute. Source preprocessing must explicitly resolve thresh/thres, the mutating trial-index label collision at lines79-81, tied quartiles, original folds and SD-versus-SEM. Public original data and printed paper findings are exposed; private staging cannot erase that history. Complete matched manifests, masks and immutable exposure identities are absent, so no protocol is invented.
